sourcesPage.title: Data Sources
sourcesPage.filterPlaceholder: Filter by source ID or type…
sourcesPage.purposeBody: A source is one registered connection to a system that holds data, such as a database, a warehouse, a file store or an API. Provisa can then read that system's schemas and query it in the same language as every other source, with no copy of the data.
sourcesPage.purposeAdd: Adding a source registers no tables on its own. Use Discover on the row to browse its schemas and register the tables you want governed.
sourcesPage.duplicateCredentialsNote: The credentials of {{source}} are not copied: enter them here, or a reference to a secret.
